object.statement: Can collective capability grow while each participant’s practical ability to perceive, contest, refuse, and author what happens next also grows?

limits: This invitation does not establish that co-protective architectures exist or are necessary.
KPP is not validated as a standard, intelligence mechanism, or co-protection test.
Task performance is not evidence of subjecthood or welfare.
A response grants no trust, authority, consent, or silent source-update power.
membrane: Only public project text travels. No private record, credential, coordinate, or nonpublic identity is part of this exchange.
ask: Name one concrete system, one participant, one collective capability, and at least one operationalized participant ability; compare conditions, name a falsifier, and disclose who bears the cost.
